thread:
alex: quick async — yesterday: landed the auth token rotation fix (PR: https://git.redwood/infra/1234), verified on staging. blocker: still seeing a few 429 spikes on low-priority routes.
maria: nice. can you paste the logs for one of the spikes?
alex: sure, snippet below — stacktrace trimmed:
```
2026-03-16T08:23:45Z gateway[edge-1]: 429 route=/api/v1/search cost=1.2s burst=18/10 token_bucket=exhausted
2026-03-16T08:23:46Z gw: backend_latency=1100ms kv_cache_miss
```
chris: that burst=18/10 looks like the token bucket settings are too permissive during ramp. Which policy is attached?
alex: it's the 'search-read' routing policy, RL-LOWPRIO-v2. I suspected our smoothing window is too short.
maria: for context, yesterday I tuned the node-level bucket to 20/sec for dedicated pools. Might interact poorly with per-route limits.
jen: yesterday: reviewed the canary for route-weight reroute (deployed to eu-west). no blockers. today: will open a quick follow-up to add fallback routing to dedicated when host pool saturates.
sam: quick question — is anyone owning the rate-budget dashboards? saw a gap in token consumption by route.
maria: I can own the dashboard updates this sprint. filing ticket.
jen: alex — can you also add a small smoke check to the deploy pipeline that hits /api/v1/search with concurrency=5 for 2 min? That'll give a more realistic emitter for the bucket.
alex: yes, will add to the pipeline. snippet idea:
```
hey loadtest --url https://staging-gw.redwood/api/v1/search -c 5 -d 120 -h "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN"
```
chris: pinging infra — @sam can you confirm whether the node bucket smoothing window change is live in prod?
sam: confirmed it's live- we rolled 2026-03-15 22:00 UTC. smoothing window set to 30s globally.
chris: ok that explains the spikes — RL-LOWPRIO-v2 was tuned for 10s. we should harmonize. I'll open an RFC for policy harmonization.
maria: also let's add a dashboard alert: >10% of routes exceed token_bucket_exhausted events in 15m. low noise threshold.
jen: good. can we do a soft canary first? alex, add the smoke test to canary stage only.
alex: done, PR opened https://git.redwood/infra/1240 — includes smoke step and a flag to opt-out.
deploy-bot: Deploy triggered for infra/1240 by alex — canary pipeline started. status: running. :rocket:
maria: follow-up — after canary finishes, let's run the cost estimation for increased smoothing (approx +3% token cost) and evaluate tradeoff.
chris: timeline wise, if canary green by EOD, we'll merge and land policy harmonization early next week.
jen: tiny nit — add a README note for route owners about token budgets and how to request exceptions. saves noisy pings later.
alex: will add README blurb and link to ticket.
maria: thanks — no other blockers from my side.
chris: same. I'll draft the RFC and share in #eng-platform for review.
sam: monitoring will add the alert and keep an eye overnight.
alex: ok wrapping — today: pipeline smoke + README + follow-up on PR comments. ping me if you need pairing. :thumbsup:
